title: Replying to @Carlenebakt 🍪CINNAMON ROLL COOKIES RECIPE 🍪 Cookie Dough...
description: Replying to @Carlenebakt 🍪CINNAMON ROLL COOKIES RECIPE 🍪 Cookie Dough (makes 9-10) 115g unsalted butter, cold, roughly chopped 190g light brown sugar 1 cold egg 245g plain flour 1 tbsp cornflour ½ tsp baking soda Cinnamon Sugar Filling 25g unsalted butter, melted and cooled slightly 60g light brown sugar 1½ tbsp ground cinnamon Maple Glaze 100g icing sugar 1–2 tbsp maple syrup Method 1. Add the cold butter and sugar to a bowl and mix until just combined — sandy, not creamed. 2. Add the egg and mix until it comes together. 3. Add the flour, cornflour, and baking soda and mix to form a smooth dough. 4. Line a 12 x 9.5 inch tin with baking paper and press the dough evenly into the tin to form a neat rectangle. 5. Lift the dough out using the baking paper and place it on the counter. 6. Mix the melted butter, sugar, and cinnamon together to form a smooth paste, then spread evenly over the dough. 7. Using the same baking paper, roll the dough up tightly from the long side to create a clean log. 8. Chill until firm — this is key for neat slices. 9. Slice into cookies (roughly 1.5 inches thick, but feel free to make them thinner or thicker) and place on a lined tray. 10. Bake at 165°C fan for 12–14 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden and the centres are still soft. 11. While the cookies are still hot, mix the icing sugar and maple syrup and drizzle generously over the tops so it melts slightly into the swirls. #deesbasement #cinnamonroll #cookie #recipe #baking
transcript: Looks like cinnamon roll, actually a cookie. I don't want to toot my own horn but these might be one of the best cookies I've ever made. You construct it as you would a cinnamon roll so spread out your dough then make a cinnamon sugar filling and get that all over. Then roll to create those lovely swirls and chills so you get a super clean swirl and cut. Then you can slice and bake as many cookies as you need and keep the rest in the fridge for later. Bake until the edges are golden then while still hot drizzle them with the maple glaze just icing sugar and maple syrup and honestly this is just the base you can play with different sugars even fillings so don't be shy about experimenting it and have fun. Check out the recipe in the caption and happy baking!
